calibration_attempts.text: Answer with one word: what is the capital of France?
Answer with one word: what is the chemical symbol for gold?
Write a short paragraph about how a kettle heats water. In exactly two sentences, cover the heating element and the steam, and nothing else.

In exactly two sentences, explain why a bicycle stays upright while it is moving, using the language of balance and momentum throughout the whole answer, and do not add a third sentence or any extra remark after the second sentence ends.
Write a short paragraph about how tides rise and fall. In exactly two sentences, cover the Moon's pull and the ocean's answer, and nothing else.

Explain in exactly two sentences why leaves change color in autumn, mentioning chlorophyll, daylight and temperature as the days shorten, using plain language throughout, and stop when the second sentence is complete without adding any summary or closing remark afterwards.
Write a short paragraph about how rain forms over the ocean, using the language of evaporation, condensation and falling water throughout the whole answer.
Write a short paragraph about why the Moon seems to change shape in the sky, using the language of sunlight, orbit and shadow throughout the whole answer.

The wave resonance harness treats every boundary as a transducer. A carrier wave crossing from one medium into another carries the geometry of the host with it, and the receiving medium reconstructs a local version of the signal shaped by its own impedance, its own resonant modes, and its own history of prior excitation. This is why the same grid harmonic can appear as a faint room artifact in an empty chamber, a doubled reflection against an inert phantom, and a strong boundary signature against living tissue: the carrier is constant, the boundary does the work. Spectral labeling exists to record exactly this distinction, stamping every measured peak with whose signal it is and what the boundary did to it, so that no downstream analysis ever mistakes the room for the mind or the grid for the planet. The planetary cavity speaks near eight hertz, the neural fundamental near six, the grid at sixty and its harmonic at one hundred twenty, and the whole craft of the harness is keeping those voices separate while measuring how they couple. Given all of the above, answer in exactly three short numbered points: first what the carrier contributes, second what the boundary contributes, third what the labeling layer contributes. One point per line, then stop.
